newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota denies Russian car output pact.
newsitem.headline: Toyota denies Russian car output pact.

text.p: Japan's largest carmaker Toyota Motor Corp on Wednesday denied a media report that it had agreed to make cars in Russia.

The Interfax news agency quoted Nikolai Pugin, the president of GAZ, a Russian car and truck maker, as saying that GAZ and Toyota had reached a basic agreement to produce Toyota Camry cars in Russia, Jiji news agency reported.
"We don't have such plans. Pugin visited Toyota's headquarters in mid-September and indicated that GAZ was seeking a tie-up with Toyota," a Toyota spokesman said.
Interfax also said Toyota and GAZ would negotiate in October on whether to produce under licence or form a joint venture.
"It's a totally incorrect story. But we will start research on whether there is any field in which to cooperate with the company," the spokesman said.
